criteria.description: A controllable player and visible start state
Keyboard left/right displacement on stable ground
Upward movement, descent and controlled platform landing
Stable standing on ground and raised platforms
Distinct coins increment count once and do not duplicate
Falling into a pit produces a failure state
A traversed level ends in a visible goal/win state
After loss, restart resets position, collected coins and round state
After win, restart restores a playable fresh round
Player/track geometry and game information remain legible
Visible instructions and restart controls match observed behavior
Visible feedback distinguishes interactions and terminal states
Requested visual style and unobstructed desktop/mobile-size layout
Observed delivery duration gated by demonstrated basic gameplay

limitations: Contributor method proposal; no maintainer acceptance, live run or calibrated gameplay verification is claimed.
Browser observation protocol, not an executable Harbor task or unattended creator adapter.
Only ordinary user interfaces and public documentation; no privileged backend/account data.
Numeric export checks cannot verify observation truth, control timing or subjective ratings.
Same-operator creation/evaluation is non-blind; disclose affiliation and context exposure.
Costs are reported separately and may be unknown; not comparable to historical 40/20/20/20 totals.
Remote URL/build labels are not byte-frozen game artifacts.
Auth, infrastructure and timeout attempts remain unscored and must be reported, not dropped.
